trust.heading: Built for the people you live with

features.heading: A grocery list that finally keeps up with the household.

instant.title: Add from anywhere
instant.desc: Type the name, pick the aisle and quantity — the item lands on the shared list in an instant. The same field as in the app, shown here as a demo.

realtime.title: Synced live
realtime.desc: Check off an item and it moves to the cart for everyone at once. No refresh, no duplicates, no mix-ups at checkout.
realtime.syncNote: 1 of 2 done · updated live on every phone

dedup.title: No more doubles
dedup.desc: SharedCart spots when two people add the same thing and quietly merges it. Items stay sorted by aisle. One milk. Always.

how.heading: Up and running in a minute.

step1.title: Create a list
step1.desc: Your household's list in seconds. A name, a color, and you're off.

step2.title: Invite your people
step2.desc: Partner, kids, roommates — one link and everyone's on the same list.

step3.title: Go shopping
step3.desc: Add, check off, tweak quantities — everything updates everywhere, instantly.

closing.title: Stop texting each other grocery lists.
closing.subtitle: Create your free account — and the whole house stays on the same page, and the same list.
closing.note: Free forever · No ads · No card
